resources.name: CursoApp API
resources.description: API endpoints collection for CursoApp (Online Course Platform). Exempts Logs and Certificates.

resources.name: Courses
resources.description: Course management and catalogue endpoints (GET is public, POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require appropriate roles)

resources.name: Tags
resources.description: Tag catalogue endpoints (GET is public, other operations require ADMIN)

resources.name: Questions
resources.description: Course lection Q&A questions endpoints (Requires authentication)

resources.name: Completions
resources.description: User lection progress and completions tracking (Requires authentication)

resources.name: Reviews
resources.description: Course reviews and ratings endpoints (Requires authentication)

resources.name: Favorites
resources.description: User course bookmarking / favorite endpoints (Requires authentication)
